subject: Every incorporated municipality, all 23 county governments, and principal state-level bodies of Wyoming
municipality_source: 2020 U.S. Census incorporation list (99 incorporated municipalities: 19 first-class cities, 80 towns; towns < 4,000 per Wyo. Stat. Title 15) cross-checked 2026-11-06 against the Wikipedia 'List of municipalities in Wyoming' (2020 Census populations). Verify against the Wyoming Secretary of State's municipal incorporation roster before relying on counts.
county_source: Wyoming Constitution Article 13 / state statutes: 23 counties; county seats per standard references.
legal_note: This registry creates watchdog configurations only. It asserts nothing about any government's conduct. All URLs are unverified candidates: nothing is enabled for crawling until tools/wyoming_verify.py live-fetches it (robots.txt honored, 3s politeness) or a human enables it.
special_districts_note: Wyoming also has dozens of school districts, conservation districts, hospital districts, rural water/sewer districts and improvement districts. They are not enumerated here (addresses/URLs cannot be verified offline). The generator supports them: add one row per district to `jurisdictions` with type 'special-district' (or 'school-district') and rerun tools/wyoming_instantiate.py --write. See docs/WYOMING-STATEWIDE-INSTANTIATION.md.
